msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia la-casa-de-las-cuentas-30.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of a pair of statement earrings with a red coral cabochon, a gold bar and a cluster of red coral drops from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia la-casa-de-las-cuentas-26.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a pair of gold sun-shaped earrings with purple stones and coral bead drops from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia la-casa-de-las-cuentas-29.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a pair of gold earrings with a purple square stone and small pearls from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia la-casa-de-las-cuentas-23.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a red coral bead cross necklace from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
